Restaurant ERP POS

Shop owner: just username + password. Cashier / staff: select your company first.

Create New Account

Create a cloud account using a username and password. Use the same account on your other devices. Business name and phone are optional.

Select Dine-In Table / Order

Touch a Dine-In table or Takeaway order to open it. Existing orders can also be opened to continue billing.

Data Backup & Restore

Export your EASY BILL LK browser data to a JSON backup, or restore it later.

Saved Data Sections

—

Backup Status

Ready

Storage

This Browser

Cloud Sync

Not Connected

1. Create Backup

Downloads a JSON file containing the EASY BILL LK data saved in this browser, including products, sales, tables, customers, stock, purchases, settings and users.

2. Restore Backup

Warning: Restoring replaces the current EASY BILL LK browser data with the selected backup. Download a backup of the current data first.

Important Notes

  • This backup works for data saved in this browser/device. It does not connect devices or create cloud sync.
  • Backup files may contain customer, sales and user information. Keep them private and store them safely.
  • Do not edit the JSON file manually unless you understand its structure.

Security & implementation notice

This page checks the signed-in Firebase UID against ebConfig/app.superAdminUids. Add the app owner's exact Firebase Authentication UID to that array in Firebase Console. Firestore Security Rules must independently enforce this allowlist for every privileged write. This HTML alone cannot safely disable Firebase Authentication accounts, revoke refresh tokens, or enforce staff bans; those operations require trusted Cloud Functions/Admin SDK.

Do not add a username, password, or public email here. Use only the exact Firebase UID.
